channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination to circumvent GOP holdouts
item.description: President Trump says he's willing to hold his nomination of Attorney General Todd Blanche until January, when he says he'll have an easier political calculation in the Senate.
item.content:encoded: President Trump says he's willing to hold his nomination of Attorney General Todd Blanche until January, when he says he'll have an easier political calculation in the Senate.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Lucas

item.title: Former Sen. Flake on what GOP objections over Blanche's nomination means for Trump
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Republican U.S. Sen. Jeff Flake what the GOP standoff over Todd Blanche's nomination suggests about the president's hold over his party in Congress.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former Republican U.S. Sen. Jeff Flake what the GOP standoff over Todd Blanche's nomination suggests about the president's hold over his party in Congress.
item.dc:creator: Leila Fadel

item.title: DOJ activates Alien Terrorist Removal Court for the first time in 30 years
item.description: The Justice Department is turning to a never-before-used court to try to deport a woman accused of pledging allegiance to the Islamic State.
item.content:encoded: The Justice Department is turning to a never-before-used court to try to deport a woman accused of pledging allegiance to the Islamic State.
item.dc:creator: Carrie Johnson

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: President Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination, Trump says a deal has been made to disarm Hamas and withdraw Israeli forces from Gaza, the U.S. economy is growing, but at a slower pace.
item.content:encoded: President Trump says he may pull Todd Blanche's nomination, Trump says a deal has been made to disarm Hamas and withdraw Israeli forces from Gaza, the U.S. economy is growing, but at a slower pace.
item.dc:creator: Michel Martin

item.title: DOMi & JD Beck talk about their second album, 'Who Asked?'
item.description: DOMi & JD Beck have been playing music together since they were teenagers. Now in their 20s and out with their second album, NPR's A Martinez asks them if they feel like mature musicians.
item.content:encoded: DOMi & JD Beck have been playing music together since they were teenagers. Now in their 20s and out with their second album, NPR's A Martinez asks them if they feel like mature musicians.

item.title: Trump says a deal has been reached to disarm Hamas
item.description: President Trump announced that a deal has been reached to disarm Hamas and withdraw Israeli forces from Gaza. But questions remain about which action will come first.
item.content:encoded: President Trump announced that a deal has been reached to disarm Hamas and withdraw Israeli forces from Gaza. But questions remain about which action will come first.
item.dc:creator: Frank Langfitt

item.title: Family and friends remember U.S. soldier killed at air base in Jordan
item.description: Family and friends remember 28-year-old Sergeant Angel Rampersad, who was killed at an air base in Jordan and is being laid to rest this week.

item.title: European soccer leaders to boycott the World Cup over FIFA private equity plan
item.description: European soccer teams voted to boycott the World Cup over a controversial FIFA investment plan. NPR's Michel Martin talks with Roger Bennett of the soccer podcast "Men in Blazers."

item.title: Trump's AI review order raises questions about federal oversight
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks to Punchbowl News tech reporter Diego Munhoz about President Trump's request for AI companies to share models with the government before their public release.

item.title: 30 beluga whales left stranded after aquarium closed are being moved to new homes
item.description: Thirty beluga whales are being transferred out of Marineland, a shuttered aquarium in Canada.
